messages:
Samir Patel: FYI, reservation queue for H100 reserved capacity in eu-west-1 just spiked. I submitted an 8-node request yesterday and support now says ETA 5-7 weeks. Anyone else seeing extended lead times? :eyes:
Lina Gomez: yep, saw the same. Cloud account console shows 'capacity constrained' for several instance families. I opened a support ticket this morning.
Marco Chen: pinging @billing-bot — did the committed discount or new reservation SKU change last week? We noticed different options in the UI.
billing-bot: (automated) Account: redwood-prod — 12 active reserved pools. Unused reserved hours since 2026-02-01: 1,680h. Projected commit headroom: 18%. See https://console.cloud/reservations/summary
Samir Patel: @Marco not sure yet. Lina, can you paste the raw reservation response? I got this error when trying to provision:
```
Request failed: capacity_unavailable
EstimatedProvisionTime: 3024000
```
Lina Gomez: Cloud support replied: "Due to hardware inventory commitments in the region, provisioning lead times are extended. Suggested alternative locations: us-west2, eu-central." They flagged this for escalation.
Olivia Park: This is starting to impact batch training on Dedicated pools. If we delay, some experiments will miss their windows. Can we shift non-critical jobs to ephemeral/spot capacity in the meantime? Costs will vary.
Marco Chen: shifting to spot reduces $/hour but increases flakiness. For real-time inference SLOs we can't risk it. We should do a mixed strategy: short-term spot for batch, reserve whatever we can for inference.
Samir Patel: Proposal: (1) reprioritize queue so inference gets first dibs; (2) spin up 4 H100 nodes in us-west2 as a short-term bridge; (3) open a committed 12-month reserved request for eu-west-1 to lock capacity. Lina, can you escalate with cloud and ask for an expedited provisioning quote for a 12-month commitment?
Lina Gomez: Escalation created: CLOUD-4621-ESC. Also filed internal ticket INFRA-1298 to handle queue triage and migrations.
infra-bot: (automated) INFRA-1298 created by Lina Gomez. Assignee: Marco Chen. Due: 2026-04-05.
Marco Chen: I'll take INFRA-1298. Also, Samir — the last invoice shows three times as many on-demand charges attached to reserved pools. Can @billing-bot reconcile reserved usage vs billed usage?
billing-bot: (automated) Reconciliation report generated: https://billing/reports/INFRA-1298-usage.csv Summary: 2 reserved pools not applied to matching projects due to tag mismatch. Potential adjustment: ~$12,400.
Olivia Park: Tagging error again 😬 We need an infra CI gate that validates reservation tags before any pool creation. Otherwise reserved discounts don't apply.
Samir Patel: Agreed. Marco, prioritize an automation check to validate reservation <-> project tag alignment. Lina, keep cloud escalation open and push for weekly status updates. If cloud can promise faster lead time with a paid commit, we should consider it.
Lina Gomez: Will follow up. For mitigation I'm scheduling the short-term move to us-west2 and creating canary jobs to validate images.
Samir Patel: Thanks. If cloud can speed provisioning, we'll cancel the spot plan. Keep posting updates here and drop the support ticket number in this thread when you get a contact. :thumbsup:
